messages.subject: Error in calling qtl2
parts:

I am finding this error in calling qtl2 library

Can anyone please help me with this.
Thanks.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Re: Error in calling qtl2
parts:
Does it happen with any other package? What operating system are you,on?

This seems like a more fundamental problem, rather than an R/qtl2 one. 
Googling “readRDS(nsInfoFilePath):error reading from connection” gets a lot of related problems.
See for example https://stackoverflow.com/questions/6473831/readrdsfile-in-r/17448816#17448816

karl
